messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy blocked by security gate for release branch 'release/v2.14' — image 'redwood/private-runtime:2026-03-20' flagged by vuln-scan (severity: HIGH). Scan ID sv-492468. Action: triage required before change window.

alex_park: ugh. which vuln is tripping it?

deploy-bot: Scan excerpt:
```
- package: libcurl
  version: 7.83.0
  finding: CVE-2024-9999 (HIGH) - remote info disclosure
  evidence: /artifacts/scan/sv-492468/results.json
```

maya_chen: confirmed, that libcurl build in our base image is the problem. upstream has a patch but it requires rebuilding the image and running a full CI matrix (smoke + integration) — estimate ~36h if we prioritize.

kevin_r: options: 1) pin to an alternate base image with patched libcurl and do a quick rebuild + smoke canary in eu-west only, 2) request temporary exception with compensating controls (runtime egress rules + WAF rules), or 3) delay full rollout until patch is validated in next change window.

sophia_g: for customer-facing release notes, we need to avoid implying vulnerability in our product. Jordan, we should say: "Deployment delayed for additional security hardening" if we hold. If we do a carveout, call it "staggered regional rollout" in notes.

jordan_rm: @security can we get an exception if we ship to EU-only canary for 24h? Customers in EU are on dedicated infra and we can isolate. Need sign-off to avoid blocking release notes schedule.

security: we can consider a timeboxed exception for eu-west canary, but require: (a) network egress disabled for canary hosts, (b) host-level WAF rule applied, (c) a signed risk acceptance doc from oncall + product. Also need repro steps and the scan output attached. If those are in place we can approve for 24h monitoring.

alex_park: I can push a quick rebuild to a patch image and run a limited smoke build now. If it passes I can tag `private-runtime:2026-03-20-patch1` and request canary deploy to EU only.

maya_chen: note — the rebuilt image will change artifact digest. deploy-bot will require a new release artifact and will re-run all supply-chain checks; that'll add ~15-30m extra pipeline time.

kevin_r: trade-offs: carving out EU only reduces blast radius but we still need to update routing/fallbacks and release notes. Also telemetry team needs a short list of canary orgs.

jordan_rm: plan proposed: (A) alex to produce patched image within next 4h and attach scan results, (B) security to review and issue 24h-eu-only exception if controls applied, (C) kevin to coordinate telemetry and route config, (D) I update release notes to "staggered regional rollout due to additional security verification" and pause global release. If security denies, we delay global rollout to next change window.

security: that sounds good. please attach the new scan ID when ready and ping me @security — target to approve by 11:00 PT or we hold.

alex_park: on it. starting rebuild now. will post new scan output when done. :hammer_and_wrench: (reaction :eyes:)

jordan_rm: thanks team — I'll update the release checklist and add a short note for customer comms.

deploy-bot: Note: when new image artifact is uploaded, CI will block until SBOM & vuln gates pass. Make sure to attach provenance link to the artifact to speed review.
